question: Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee represented Calcutta University in the Bengal Legislative Council during _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1894 - 1895**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee** was a prominent Indian barrister, politician, and social reformer who played a significant role in the country's political history.
 
• He was the **first President of the Indian National Congress** and advocated for various reforms to uplift Indian society during colonial times.
 
• During the years **1894 - 1895**, Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee represented **Calcutta University** in the Bengal Legislative Council. This was a significant achievement and highlighted his contribution to education and governance.
 
• The Bengal Legislative Council was an important body under British rule, and representation in such councils was a mark of recognition for leaders during that era.
 
• Bonnerjee, through his position, worked to address educational and societal issues, fostering progress and reforms in Bengal. *Hence, the correct answer is 1894 - 1895__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee:**

 
 
• **Born in 1844**, Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee was the first Indian to preside over the **Indian National Congress** in 1885.
 
• He was deeply involved in Indian politics and worked extensively for the rights and representation of Indians during British colonial rule.
 
• Bonnerjee also contributed to reforms in education, legal practices, and governance, playing an influential role in shaping modern India.
 
 
 
• **Bengal Legislative Council:**
 
 
• The Bengal Legislative Council was established during British rule as part of the administrative structure for governing the region.
 
• It served as an advisory body, and representation in such councils provided leaders like Bonnerjee the platform to address socio-political and educational issues.
 
 
 
• **Calcutta University:**
 
 
• Founded in **1857**, Calcutta University was one of the first institutions of higher education in India and played a pivotal role in advancing education.
 
• Representing Calcutta University in the Bengal Legislative Council reflected Bonnerjee's commitment to education and intellectual development in Bengal.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of Representation:**

 
 
• Representation in the Bengal Legislative Council allowed Indian leaders to voice their concerns and advocate for reforms in governance and education.
 
• Bonnerjee’s role as the representative of Calcutta University highlighted the importance of education and intellectual contributions in shaping policies.
 
 
 
• **Contributions to Education:**
 
 
• Bonnerjee emphasized the need for accessible and quality education, which he believed was crucial for India’s progress.
 
• Calcutta University served as a hub for intellectuals and reformers, fostering the growth of leaders who shaped India’s future.
